'''Alu Cymmuj''' was an individual who resided on the planet [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Cymmuj was known to visit the [[Marblewood Estate]] in [[Iltarr City]], the residence of the local [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Black Sun sector chief|Sector Chief]] [[Avrak Villachor]].<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>
